d: Durai's life takes a drastic turn after he revolts against Dharmalingam, Aalavandar and Punniyakodi, three corrupt politicians, when they try to defy the rules at a fair-price shop.
Mayandi kills inspector Gopal and his family except for Rudhra, who finds evidence against him and shows it to the police. However, when an officer begins torturing her, Rudhra vows to kill Mayandi.
Rajesh, a junior lawyer, marries Radha, the daughter of a famous lawyer. He feels ignored due to her closeness with her father and to get back at them, he takes up a high-profile murder case.
